Kill [[Barthimus the Provident]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Barthimus the Provident]] in [[Cursed Lands (War in Kryta)|Cursed Lands]]
* *BONUS* Kill Barthimus the Provident in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 10 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
The fastest way to Barthimus avoids most enemies along the way.

Leave the [[Temple of the Ages]] with a balanced group. Either rescue your [[War in Kryta#Escorts|escort]] from the [[Reed Stalker]]s or just run east. Evade or dispatch the [[undead]] and make your way through the swamp.
After the swamp, you need to cross the path. Wait a few seconds for the patrols to move away, then cross it without engaging any foes. Move past the [[Resurrection Shrine]], then east. Dispatch the small White Mantle group without engaging the [[Lynx (beast)|Lynx]]. There are a few White Mantle [[popup]]s before the exit to [[Cursed Lands (War in Kryta)|Cursed Lands]]. If you're quick you can run past them to the [[portal]].

In the Cursed Lands, your new escort is likely to [[aggro]] the group of Lynx. You can take it slow, dispatch each group, then tackle Barthimus. It's faster, but riskier, to lead the Lynx, other wildlife and the White Mantle to each other - they're hostile to each other. You can use the ensuing chaos to [[spike]] Barthimus, then [[map-travel]] back to [[Lion's Arch]].
